originalTranscript: chicken nuggets ki recipe.  Kaunse type? Acha nuggets, ok. 1/2 kg chicken boneless chicken lena.  Usko chote chote pieces me karke uska keema bana lena. Fir uske baad uske andar 2 teaspoon garlic powder, fir 1 teaspoon peri peri masala aur aur kya dala tha? Araam se boliye urgent karne ko. half teaspoon kali mirchi powder aur half teaspoon ya half teaspoon se zara zyada  laal mirchi powder aur namak ek  half teaspoon se zara kam ya half teaspoon inch namak. Jab keema iska bana lete hain chicken ka, uske baad isme garlic powder, lal mirchi powder, kali mirchi powder, namak aur  ye peri peri masala aur ek quarter teaspoon mixed herbs nahi to oregano dal ke pura mix kar dena.  Itni tumhari recipe, uske baad cutlet yeh nuggets banane ke liye shape de dena aur ek ande me ek namak kali mirchi dal ke phet lena. Usme yeh jo nugget shape dete hain wo dip karna aur bread crumb pe coat karke deep fry bhi kar sakte hain, shallow fry bhi kar sakte hain. Nuggets ki recipe itni chhi.
englishTranscript: Chicken nuggets recipe. What kind? Oh, nuggets, okay. Take 1/2 kg chicken, boneless chicken. Cut it into small pieces and mince it. Then, after that, add 2 teaspoons of garlic powder, then 1 teaspoon of peri-peri masala, and what else did we add? Speak slowly to do it urgently. Half teaspoon of black pepper powder and half teaspoon or slightly more than half teaspoon of red chilli powder, and salt a little less than half teaspoon or half teaspoon of salt. Once you make the mince of the chicken, after that, add garlic powder, red chilli powder, black pepper powder, salt, and this peri-peri masala, and a quarter teaspoon of mixed herbs or oregano, mix it all together. That's your recipe, after that shape it to make cutlets or nuggets, and beat an egg with a little salt and black pepper. Dip the shaped nuggets in it and coat them in bread crumbs; you can deep fry or shallow fry them. That's the nuggets recipe.
name: Chicken Nuggets
description: A homemade minced chicken nugget recipe seasoned with garlic powder, peri-peri masala, and herbs, then coated in breadcrumbs and fried.

ingredients.name: boneless chicken, cut into small pieces and minced

steps.text: Add garlic powder, peri-peri masala, black pepper powder, red chilli powder, salt, mixed herbs or oregano to the minced chicken and mix well.
In a separate bowl, beat the egg with a little salt and black pepper.
Dip the shaped nuggets into the beaten egg and coat them with bread crumbs.
Deep fry or shallow fry the coated nuggets until done.
